question: Field report 25 Sep 2026: the newborn-kit desk is hurt by freight and municipal corruption. Test at primary sources whether the archive's 'thin-field premium' is partly a directed/uncontested premium, price freight on bulky kits, and find a repaired desk or say stop.

findings.what_it_shows: Pregão PRESENCIAL 010/2025-CCC (kits maternidade, SRP): 12.960 kits to VITÓRIA RÉGIA (Manaus, CNPJ 27.698.768/0001-37) at R$675,37/kit and a 1.440-kit ME quota to OLIVEIRA CONFECÇÃO E SERVIÇOS DE IMPRESSÃO at R$676,00; all 15 items awarded at 99,3-100,0% of estimate (banheira R$62,70 vs R$63,11; PNCP percentualDesconto 0,6496%). ARP ceiling R$9.726.235. This is the archive's 'thin field' worth 34,8% of its clearing pool.
findings.status: verified at primary source; no ruling on this lot found

findings.what_it_shows: Compra 2025/238 posted to PNCP 2026-03-16; proposals closed 2025-03-14; ARP signed 25 Mar 2025 (arquivos/4). Published 367 days after the session: invisible to an art. 54 PNCP cron, and its 'market value' entered a 12-month harvest after its ARP had expired.

Edital: session in person at Coari city hall (river town, no road link), invokes art. 17 §§2º-5º with no stated reason, MENOR PREÇO POR LOTE, cartório-authenticated copies 2 working days before, atestado of ≥10% of quantities (=1.440 kits delivered), adesões up to 2× the registered quantity.
Births 1.440 / 1.429 / 1.300 per year: 14.400 kits registered = 11,1× a year of births (2026 eletrônico still 6.300 = 4,8×).

NATURAL EXPERIMENT: same buyer, same object, Pregão ELETRÔNICO 47/2026 (homologated 3 Sep 2026): lot cleared at 0,593 of estimate (ME lot 0,773); banheira anatômica R$62,70→R$25,00 (-60%), macacão R$43,00→R$25,00 (-42%), kit cueiro R$43,95→R$26,00 (-41%), kit banho R$31,96→R$21,00 (-34%). At Sol's verified cost the 2026 banheira is -19% and the macacão +22%. Winners again Amazonas generalists (PONTO NORTE AMAZONIA, Manaus, 67 secondary CNAEs; VITALOG, Urucará, 94).

9 Apr 2025, MPAM recommendation nº 2025/0000042102.02PROM_CIZ to mayor Adail Pinheiro after a complaint about 'sete editais de licitação em 2024, todos na modalidade presencial, sem justificativas compatíveis'.

findings.what_it_shows: CEIS+CNEP bulk 24 Sep 2026 matched against 400 distinct kit-line winners: 27 listed (6,8%), holding 1,5% of line value — mostly 'impedimento' by other municípios (local in scope, so they keep bidding). None of the Coari winners is listed. Sanction lists do not catch this pattern.

corruption.red_flag_prevalence: Full list of 2.751 newborn-kit compras on PNCP (2021-2026): Pregão Presencial 34 (1,2%), Dispensa 963 (35%). Posted to PNCP AFTER proposals closed: 7,8% of pregões eletrônicos (135/1.733), 22,9% of dispensas (123/538), 38,2% of presenciais (13/34). Line sample (2.518 award lines, 572 editais with results published since Jan 2025): award÷estimate median 0,64 on on-time pregão eletrônico (11,4% of lines at ≥0,98) vs 0,994 on presencial (53,1% at ≥0,98, n=32) and 0,97 on dispensa (45,9%). Margin at Sol's published São Paulo cost rises monotonically with award÷estimate: median gross −21,8% below 0,6 → +15,1% (0,6-0,8) → +20,9% (0,8-0,98) → +35,3% at ≥0,98. The component pool clearing ≥50% gross (R$7,48M in sample; R$5,38M ex-Coari): 89,9% won by a firm in the buyer's own state, 7,1% by São Paulo firms; 49,9% sits in presencial / post-hoc-published / no-discount lines (30,3% ex-Coari); only 5,3% (7,4% ex-Coari) is clean AND was won by an out-of-state firm — the only slice a distant bidder has demonstrably captured. When an out-of-state firm wins a component line it clears at 0,625 of estimate = −6,2% gross at her cost (São Paulo firms selling out of state: 0,537, −11,1%); local winners 0,809, +18,3%. Kits under 300 units: local 0,86 of estimate (median R$250) vs out-of-state 0,611 (R$178,85); 300-1.000 kits: 0,706 vs 0,518. Generalist winners (≥40 secondary CNAEs; 110 of 400 winners) take 31,1% of the clearing value vs 24,2% of the rest; median gross at her cost when they win +29,3% vs +11,8% when a specialist (<10 CNAEs) wins. Kits registered vs annual births (IBGE t.2612, 2024): median 0,89×, 16,2% of editais >2×, 3,2% >5× (Coari 11,1×, Nhamundá 11,0×, Icatu 7,0×, Taiobeiras bolsas 12×). CEIS/CNEP: 6,8% of winners listed, 1,5% of value — sanction lists are not the filter.
corruption.verdict: PARTLY YES, AND IT DOES NOT MATTER WHICH PART. The thin-field premium is an UNCONTESTED-LOT premium: the margin lives in lines awarded at or near the estimate, ~90% of it is captured by in-state firms (disproportionately local generalist 'empresas balcão'), and the moment a distant firm wins, the price falls to where her cost is under water. At least some of it is directed: the archive's single largest thin field (Coari, 34,8% of its clearing pool) was a presencial pregão in a river town, posted to PNCP a year late, awarded at 99,3-100% of estimate on every item, for 11× the town's births, by a municipality under an MP recommendation for unjustified presencial tenders and a TCE-AM docket alleging systematic direcionamento — and when the same buyer went electronic in 2026 the same banheira cleared 60% lower. PNCP data cannot separate directed from honest-local, and no court or TCE has ruled on a kit lot (UNVERIFIED as fraud). For the desk the distinction is moot: neither premium is capturable by an out-of-state bidder — in a directed lot she is excluded, in an honest thin lot her arrival is what removes the premium.

freight.vs_margin: The archive's kit margin is +36% to +53% gross at the published São Paulo tier on the award the WINNER got (Itaquaquecetuba R$359,05). Against that: a boxed kit with a bathtub costs 58% of a R$296,84 Maranhão kit by Correios PAC (37% even to Belo Horizonte); 40-52% per unit by observed LTL at 5 units to the Northeast, with no scale economy (Farrapos refuses 20 units); 9-10% only on a full 6-axle carreta at the ANTT floor, which needs ~800+ kits (≈R$240k of billings, ≈R$130k of COGS — 8× her R$15.600 float); a median ~105-kit lot on its own truck is 39,5% at the floor to Maranhão and 14% to northern Minas. Freight scales with VOLUME, not value, so it bites hardest on the bathtub-and-bag kits that carry the thin-field prices. And the margin itself is overstated for a distant bidder: at the price out-of-state firms actually clear (0,625 of estimate), the component gross at her cost is −6,2% before freight (banheira −18%, macacão −16%, toalha −12%). Only DENSE textiles survive both: fralda de pano +40,8% and manta +31,5% gross at out-of-state prices, with PAC freight ≈7% of value to the Northeast.

repair_options.option: A. Contestability + integrity pre-bid filter (added to the 11 rules): reject Pregão Presencial; reject lots posted to PNCP <8 working days before close or after it; reject kits registered >2× the município's annual births (IBGE SIDRA t.2612, one call); reject where the same object's last award was ≥0,95 of estimate to an in-state winner; keep the SICONFI >30%-unpaid reject (Coari 35,9% fails it); treat 'local generalist with ≥40 secondary CNAEs won last time' as a warning.
repair_options.evidence: Flags catch Coari, Arinos, Maués, Nhamundá, Icatu, Benjamin Constant, Taiobeiras. But the market left after filtering is the contested one: out-of-state winners clear at 0,625 of estimate, −6,2% median gross at her published cost; only 5,3-7,4% of the clearing pool is clean and demonstrably winnable from outside.
repair_options.verdict: NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT. It stops the losses the founder is describing (bids wasted on directed lots, amostra/presencial exclusion, non-payers) and removes most of the margin the archive counted. Build it anyway — it costs a few API calls per edital.

repair_options.option: B. Dense-SKU desk: bid component lines of fralda de pano, manta (and cueiro/flanela, unmeasured) instead of bathtub-and-bag kits.
repair_options.evidence: Only families positive at out-of-state clearing prices at the published tier: fralda de pano +40,8%, manta +31,5%; dense 10 kg box PAC to MA/PI R$106 ≈ 7% of value. Size (archive, 12 months, spec-controlled): fralda pano R$525.524 + manta R$910.918 = R$1,44M/yr total, R$0,85M clearing ≥50% — a 15-25% share is R$215-360k of billings ⇒ ≈R$42-74k/yr net ≈ US$650-1.200/month.
repair_options.verdict: SURVIVES BOTH freight and corruption, FAILS THE BAR ALONE (below US$2.000). Keep it as the atestado-minting and cash-flow core.

repair_options.option: C. Radius limit: bulky items only within ~1.300 road-km of São Paulo (MG, RJ, ES, PR, GO/DF, SC, MS, interior SP buyers are worst-priced — de-prioritise).
repair_options.evidence: LTL per bulky unit to BH/Montes Claros R$20,66/27,16 at 20 units; ANTT floor for a median lot on a toco 14% to Montes Claros vs 39,5% to Maranhão; MG lines won by out-of-state firms still clear +12,8% median gross at published cost (n=80; +39,0% at cost ×0,70), against −4,9% for all near-region and −8,5% for N/NE out-of-state wins. NE bulky kits are freight-dead below truckload.
repair_options.verdict: REPAIR — works only with a supplier discount: at cost ×0,70 the out-of-state median becomes +25,7% (banheira +17%, macacão +19%, toalha +22%), minus 7-14% freight and ~5,65% Simples.

repair_options.option: D. Supplier account (the archive's unrun step 1) — now the gate for C.
repair_options.evidence: Out-of-state-cleared component gross at her cost: −6,2% at published tier → +25,7% at 30% off → +41,6% at 45% off. Still an inference: nobody has been asked.
repair_options.verdict: DECISIVE AND UNTESTED — with Portuguese calls now allowed this is a phone afternoon, not an email campaign.

repair_options.option: E. Regional supply for Northeast lots (Pernambuco Agreste cluster: Santa Cruz do Capibaribe / Caruaru / Toritama) shipping direct under venda à ordem.
repair_options.evidence: PE→MA ≈1.400 km vs SP→MA ≈3.000 km; the archive recorded a PE-phone seller at R$7,99/body vs R$15,32 in the Brás. No verified CNPJ-priced PE wholesale or PE-origin LTL quote obtained; interstate ICMS on a triangular sale is an accountant question.
repair_options.verdict: UNVERIFIED — worth one day of calls; would reopen the NE only for dense+medium items, not for the local-incumbent premium.

repair_options.evidence: Archive: visible private market ≈3.356 kits/yr (Bird 2.180 + Central dos Benefícios 1.176); the bar needs ≈43% of it; gift obligations are discharged by prepaid cards.
repair_options.verdict: NOT ALONE — margin layer on top of A-D.

repair_options.option: G. Stop the Northeast/North bathtub-kit arbitrage as designed.
repair_options.evidence: Every leg of it fails: the premium there is local/uncontested (and at Coari, directed), freight is 40-58% of a kit below truckload, truckload needs 8× her capital, and several of the named high-price buyers are non-payers (Coari 35,9% unpaid; Icatu and Nhamundá 0% paid per the archive).

law: ★★★ THE THIN-FIELD PREMIUM BELONGS TO WHOEVER IS ALREADY THERE — PRICE A LOT AT WHAT OUT-OF-STATE WINNERS CLEAR, NEVER AT WHAT THE WINNER GOT. Measured 25 Sep 2026 on 2.518 newborn-kit award lines (572 editais since Jan 2025): margin at Sol's São Paulo cost rises monotonically with award÷estimate (median −21,8% below 0,6 → +35,3% at ≥0,98); 89,9% of the value clearing ≥50% gross was won by a firm in the buyer's own state and 7,1% by São Paulo firms; only 5,3% (7,4% ex-Coari) was clean AND won from outside. When an out-of-state firm won, it cleared at 0,625 of estimate — −6,2% gross at her cost. The archive's largest thin field, Coari/AM (34,8% of its clearing pool), was a pregão PRESENCIAL in a river town, posted to PNCP 367 days after the session, awarded at 99,3-100% of estimate on all 15 items, for 11× the town's births, under an MP recommendation about unjustified presencial editais — and when the same buyer re-tendered electronically in 2026 the banheira fell R$62,70 → R$25,00 and the lot cleared at 0,593. ⇒ A thin field's premium is the price of nobody else arriving; a distant bidder either removes it by arriving or, where the field is directed, is removed. `THE CLEARING PRICE IS SET BY WHO BOTHERED TO BID` stays true; its corollary `bid thin fields` is withdrawn for any bidder who is not local. Screen every lot on the OUT-OF-STATE clearing ratio for that SKU, and reject presencial, post-hoc-published and >2×-births lots before pricing. ★ And FREIGHT SCALES WITH VOLUME, NOT VALUE: a kit boxed around a 21 L bathtub costs R$172 by PAC to Maranhão (58% of a R$296,84 kit), R$119-154 a unit by LTL at five units, and 9-10% only on a full 6-axle carreta at the ANTT floor — ~800 kits, 8× her capital — while a 10 kg box of cloth diapers costs ~7%. Dense goods survive distance; bulky goods survive only a truckload or a short road.
recommendation_detail: Repair, narrowly, with the NE/North bathtub-kit arbitrage stopped today. The repaired desk = dense textile components anywhere (fralda de pano, manta, cueiro) + bulky items only within ~1.300 road-km + the contestability/integrity filter (option A) + bids priced at the out-of-state clearing ratio, not the median award. Honest floor at the published tier: ≈US$650-1.200/month (dense SKUs alone). It reaches US$2.000-2.500 only if a supplier account at ≥30% off published materialises, which turns near-radius banheira/macacão/toalha positive at out-of-state prices. NEXT TEST (R$0, Portuguese calls now allowed, bar committed in advance): (1) call 15 Brás + 5 Agreste wholesalers for faturado prices — PASS if ≥3 quote at ≤0,70× the verified published cost (banheira 24 L ≤R$20,80, macacão ≤R$13,72, manta ≤R$8,53, fralda de pano ≤R$1,72/piece); (2) call 3 LTL carriers (e.g. Braspress, Patrus, Jamef) for SP→Montes Claros and SP→São Luís, 1 m³/150 kg — PASS if ≤R$300/m³ to Montes Claros; (3) re-screen every bid already placed through option A and count how many losses fell in flagged lots. If (1) fails: run the dense-SKU desk as a side business below the bar and stop investing in the kit desk.
unverified: That any specific kit lot (including Coari 010/2025) was fraudulent or directed — no TCE, CGU, court or MP ruling on a kit tender was found; the evidence is process red flags plus a documented pattern at the same buyer.
TCE-AM decisions on Coari Pregão Presencial 42/2025 (suspension, May 2025) and the 2026 direcionamento representation are known only from news sites, not the TCE-AM decision texts.
BRINK MOBIL's R$20,2M overpricing allegation on São Paulo's Mãe Paulistana is a losing bidder's claim.

Truck useful volumes (30 / 48 / 95 m³) and the 0,10 m³ per boxed kit are assumptions; the ANTT figures are statutory FLOORS excluding tolls, insurance, GRIS and ICMS on freight — market prices are higher by an unmeasured amount.
No real fractional (LTL) quote for Sol's own kit from a B2B carrier; the Alô Bebê quotes are a consumer store's contracted rates for a 0,149 m³ bathtub package, origin not confirmed as São Paulo.
Correios contract (non-balcão) discounts for a new ME are unknown; the quotes used are retail counter prices.
The 6.000 cubic factor and 10 kg threshold come from secondary help pages (the identical 5 kg/14 kg quotes are consistent with them).

Line sample is partial: 572 of 1.100 kit editais with results since Jan 2025 (PNCP latency 0,5-15 s all afternoon); the component cost basis reuses the archive's single-supplier Emilio prices and a simplified spec filter; kit BOMs are not priced per edital.
The 'winner in same UF' metric uses the winner's registered head-office UF (minhareceita), which misses branches.
Pernambuco Agreste wholesale prices and PE→NE LTL rates; interstate ICMS/DIFAL treatment of a triangular (venda à ordem) sale into a São Paulo Simples ME.
The dense-SKU pool size is the archive's 12-month spec-controlled figure (R$1,44M total, R$0,85M clearing), not re-measured here; cueiro/flanela lines are unmeasured.
Nhamundá and Icatu payment records (0,0% paid) are the archive's SICONFI measurement, not re-fetched here; Coari's 35,9% was re-fetched.
